purpose: every method that appears in a CST Anti-UAV table of this study: what it is, what it was trained on, how it is initialised and scored, and which file pins it
protocol: one-pass evaluation from the GT box of frame 0; state accuracy (paper Eq. 1) by the official toolkit github.com/PCwenyue/CST-Anti-UAV @ bd92b984 (experiments/cst_anti_uav/scripts/official_eval.py); 60 CST test sequences

released_baselines.source: authors' released CST-trained predictions TrainedCST.zip (Google Drive file 1APnukttZsoeFzRrsTYQY0aWxAlqU3QQU), 17,436,199 bytes, sha256 1c886465697be55d0a9ee3f7682ad37fb6afb367ab2cb4eae2ede51b577fbccd; per-file sha256 in official_reproduction_test/official_scores.json
released_baselines.training_data: CST train (120 sequences), official implementations, pre-trained models and default configurations (paper section 4.1); checkpoints not released
missing_from_archive: STFTrack (listed in utils/trackers.py, not in the paper's tables)
released_baselines.verified: all 21 reproduce Table 3 mSA / P / S to rounding (report_reproduction.py exits non-zero otherwise)

common.tracker: experiments/systems/scripts/ste.py (single-target state estimator: constant-velocity Kalman filter on cached detections, Mahalanobis gate, coasting, re-acquisition, absence) and argmax (best detection >= thr, else absent); experiments/systems/scripts/track_eval.py::run_tracker
common.detector: YOLO11n as built in this project (network 'n', 9-channel window stem, function-preserving init from COCO yolo11n.pt), letterbox 640, fp16 on the V100; detections cached with conf >= 0.01, NMS IoU 0.7, max_det 10 (experiments/systems/scripts/cache_detections.py)
common.initialisation: STE.reset(GT box of frame 0); no later GT; causal window frames (t-4, t, t-8) or the single frame (t, t, t)
common.settings: tuned on CST VAL (official 40 sequences), frozen and committed before TEST
